items.prose: Fine stratospheric volcanic silicate ash mixed with atmospheric humidity formed a rock-hard, cement-like cake eighty millimeters thick across the coarse louvers. Intake blowers overloaded on thermal protection; airflow dropped from 22,000 CFM down to barely 3,900 CFM.

Photoionization detector on the clean air plenum registered complete breakthrough of sulfur dioxide and benzene vapors. The two-ton coconut-shell activated charcoal bed has reached 100% moisture and hydrocarbon saturation after thirty months of continuous run.

Accumulated beta activity (over 12,000 disintegrations/sec/cm²) degraded the borosilicate micro-fiberglass binder. The filter medium turned dark yellow and brittle as dry leaves; differential air pressure blew twelve large tears through the paper pleats.

Heavy carbon soot from diesel exhaust backwash baked onto the chromium-plated poppet guide shafts. When tested with a 2-bar simulated shock wave, the primary blast valve seized at 40% travel, failing to achieve positive pressure lock.

Sub-zero -32°C winter fog froze solid across the stainless steel insect and debris mesh, forming a six-inch impenetrable sheet of clear glaze ice. Bunker oxygen levels dropped to 17.5% across all sleeping quarters before an emergency crew chipped the ice clear with axes.

Dozens of mutated roof rats and bats seeking heat from the intake duct died against the pre-filter face during a severe winter blizzard. Decomposing carcasses blocked half the cross-sectional intake area and filled the lower workshops with sickening putrefaction odors.

Failure of the six-bar compressed air regulator prevented the automatic cleaning reverse-pulse solenoid valves from firing. The heavy woven Nomex filter bags collapsed inward under two tons of accumulated dry fallout dust, stalling the main ventilation motors.
